points.label: Belonging and imitation
points.left: A mistaken view of the righteous gives way to creation and immortality. The passage then names envy, death, and belonging.
points.right: The scene disputes descent from Abraham, attempted killing, and true fatherhood. It also names desire, murder, truth, lies, hearing, and belonging.

payload.posture: Read both WEBU passages side by side. Keep each passage’s actors, setting, order, and identity claims distinct.

rightEvidence.title: The devil is described as murderer and father of lies

payload.tension: Both sources connect the devil with death, but they speak to different people and make different arguments.
